scope: Minimal converter dependencies and preservation constraints; no installation/build executed.
CPU: GGUF v3 reader with type40 NVFP4(64 elements,36 bytes)
quantize_nvfp4.py preserving source Q4_K/Q6_K decode, E4M3 SF and E2M1 law
GPU: CUDA toolkit with cuda_fp4.h/cuda_fp8.h (historically tested CUDA13.0)
MSVC x64 v14.38 runtime/toolchain for the converter DLL
gpu_conversion.py ctypes ABI plus convert_gpu.dll explicitly built from corresponding convert_gpu.cu
Strata codec.cuh plus strata/qwen35/native/quant.hpp include; CUDA fp16/fp4/fp8 runtime headers
CUDA shared runtime DLL visible on process PATH; no dependency on a running model or native-service process

GPU_ABI.allocation_scope: One tensor at a time; original+F32decode+packedoutput+smallstats allocations freed at function exit.

compile_status: Documentation only. New parameterized entry must not compile, load models, infer, or run probes automatically.
codec_reference_warning: Frozen conversion driver signature covers convert_gpu.cu+codec.cuh but does not record a complete SDK/transitive-header closure in its compact local receipt. New tools should record codec+quant+CUDA versions/DLL SHA; do not claim local vision-source reference equals the exact historical remote codec without a hash certificate.
runtime_compatibility: The current223 cold_head_binding intentionally pins the known main/head provenance and geometry. A new generic conversion is not automatically a qualified current223 asset; never forge known SHA metadata to bypass this check.
lifetime_and_publication: All taskTEMP/TMP/cache/partial/chunk/status files in Y:\temp or a task child.
L:\models is the durable publication destination; do not use it for temporary .partial files.
Create new outputs exclusively; never silently overwrite.
Read/validate source; write bounded temporary file; fsync; validate GGUF directory and tensor extents; compute whole output SHA; publish and receipt only after success.
A cross-volume Y-to-L copy is not an atomic rename; verify final bytes/hash and retain recoverable source until publication succeeds.
historical_script_limitations: convert_original.py hardcodes source/output paths and source size+mtime; not a portable CLI. Existing-output reuse checks receipt/size but does not rehash whole file.
head_fp4_convert.py hardcodes the original-derived input identity, output subdirectory and full source stat; useful frozen provenance, not the new general entry.
run_conversion_batch.py builds a DLL and invokes old fixture gates. It is historical evidence and must not be invoked for file-only cleanup.
minimal_tool_improvements: Implemented: explicit --source/--output/--head-output/--work-dir/--backend; both main and independent head are always produced, no selection switch and no hardcoded model mtime.
Implemented: optional explicit prebuilt --gpu-library; no implicit compilation or model/inference execution. There are no inspect/verify-only subcommands in this CLI.
Implemented: full input/output SHA and implementation identity, tensor selection receipt, bounded buffers, exclusive publication, and refused incomplete target/receipt pairs.
Preserved: original three-neighbor SF mathematics and exact untouched tensor copy; new independent head uses two CPU passes. A future search/format change needs a separate versioned artifact.

basis: Main metadata order and raw record copy plus type40/tensor-scale selection match frozen writer for the known original basename; no new GGUF fields alter known061 layout.
quantize_nvfp4.py, GGUF reader and CUDA encode/decode source byteexact to frozen originals. CPU chunk/global/SF/RNE math unchanged.
Head uses full-main SHA, header SHA, original Q6-head SHA and norm SHA together before retaining historical logical name; new data never receives a forged historical identity.
Head full-tensor global two-pass source hash and output.weight/scale/norm order/offsets match old writer.
Imports requiring NumPy/CUDA occur after Windows Ytemp confinement. No automatic compilation/model loading/inference.
All partial/status/receipt staging remain under Ytemp; explicit final output copy uses xb, fsync and full SHA; completed receipt published only after data succeeds.
Existing output reuse checks passed receipt, exact request/implementation identity, full file size+SHA; incomplete output/receipt or conflicting path refuses overwrite.
Both input and implementation source identities rechecked before publication; failure leaves recoverable partial/status without success claim.

static_peer_review.limits: Static source review only. No converter module imports, conversion, compilation, CUDA loading or new weight execution performed.
